facts.status_note: The tower was dynamited in 1965 according to Mountain Wandering; SummitPost describes the foundations of the old tower.

corrections.proposed: New Hampshire Forestry Department, then White Mountain National Forest from 1939
corrections.why: The brief's agency value is a fragment of a 1915-16 note on the Eastern US Lookouts page, not an agency name. The same page records the 1939 handover to the White Mountain National Forest.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Mountain Wandering dates a fire tower on the summit to 1911. The Eastern US Lookouts page lists a new and improved watch tower in 1915-16 and a 1924 plan for four new towers including Cabot. The sources do not say whether these were one structure or successive towers.

sources.title: Mt Cabot Cabin
sources.publisher: White Mountain National Forest, USDA Forest Service

notes_for_editor: The 1911 start and 1965 dynamiting both rest on one hiking blog; state records were not reached. SummitPost is undated, so the foundations are described as seen in its text. No staffing or fire records found. Brief's agency field was a parsing fragment and is corrected. The FS page spells the trail 'Killkenny'; quoted as printed.
